doc_metadata.notes: Rated criteria response form for HR Advisory services procurement. Establishes submission format requirements and evaluation criteria structure for proponent responses across seven rated categories: Corporate Profile, Key Personnel and Roster, Methodology & Advisory Approach, Thought Leadership & Innovation, Relationship Management, Value-added, and Relevant Experience and References.
doc_metadata.title: APPENDIX D2 - RATED CRITERIA RESPONSE FORM – HR Advisory

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of proponent's organizational description, purpose, structure, makeup, employee count, products and services offered, range and depth of experience, core areas of expertise, and identification of requirements outside firm's scope.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their organisation, its purpose, structure and makeup. Responses should include: Profile and history of the organisation; Number of employees; A list and description of the products and services you offer in support of the objectives and scope described in this service category, the range and depth of your experience with each, and identify which are your core areas of expertise or specialty; A list of any of our requirements that fall outside your firm's scope.
source_refs.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D2 - Rated Criteria Response Form.docx

evaluation_criteria.title: Corporate Profile

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of proponent's team capabilities and capacity, including key personnel profiles (maximum 4 individuals in dedicated roles) and description of available practitioner talent, vetting processes, quality standards, and resource assignment methodology.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, lead consultant, research specialist.

evaluation_criteria.title: Key Personnel and Roster

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of proponent's approach to delivering HR advisory services and managing consulting engagements, including needs assessment methodology, recommendations development, governance and project management, stakeholder engagement, change management, and quality assurance processes.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their approach to delivering HR advisory services and managing consulting engagements. Responses should include: The methodology used to assess organizational needs and define desired outcomes; Approach to developing recommendations and implementation plans; Governance model and project management approach; Stakeholder engagement and consultation methodologies; Change management and communication approaches, where applicable; and Quality assurance processes.

evaluation_criteria.title: Methodology & Advisory Approach

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of proponent's ability to provide strategic insights, innovative solutions, and leading practices, including examples of innovative implementations, experience with research and data analytics, methods for staying current with HR trends, examples of meaningful organizational improvements, and two published thought leadership samples (maximum 2 pages each).

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their ability to provide strategic insights, innovative solutions, and leading practices for the requirements listed in section 4.1 of the RFP. Responses should include: Examples of innovative solutions or approaches implemented for clients; Experience applying research, data analytics, benchmarking, or emerging HR practices to address client challenges; Methods used to remain current with HR trends and industry developments; Examples of recommendations that resulted in meaningful organizational improvements; and Two (2) samples of published articles, white papers, research, frameworks, or thought leadership materials developed by the Proponent (maximum limit of 2 pages per sample).

evaluation_criteria.title: Thought Leadership & Innovation

evaluation_criteria.notes: Evaluation of proponent's approach to establishing, maintaining, and strengthening client relationships, including account management structure, client-facing roles, communication and reporting practices, client expectation management, escalation procedures, client satisfaction monitoring, and example of successful response to changing requirements or issue resolution.

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to describe their approach to establishing, maintaining, and strengthening client relationships throughout the term of the Contract. The response should include: Account management structure and governance processes; Key client-facing roles and responsibilities; Communication and reporting practices; Approach to managing client expectations and competing priorities; Escalation and issue-resolution procedures; Methods used to monitor client satisfaction and obtain feedback; and An example of how the Proponent successfully responded to changing client requirements or resolved a significant client issue.

requirements.description: Key Personnel and Roster: Proponents must demonstrate capabilities and capacity by describing their team, including internal and external resources. Response must include brief profiles (no more than half a page each) for maximum of 4 individuals who would serve in dedicated relationship or coordination roles with the Bank, with name, proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Additionally, proponents must describe the practitioner talent available internally or externally, including range of expertise, vetting and development processes, quality and consistency standards for associates or contractors, and typical resource assignment process.
requirements.evidence: Key personnel profiles and roster description

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, lead consultant, research specialist. These are the people we expect to interact with consistently, independent of any specific engagement. The profile should include: name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Describe the practitioner talent your firm can draw on, internally or externally. Rather than listing names or submitting bios for all potential resources, tell us about your bench/roster: the range of expertise available, how practitioners are vetted and developed, how you ensure quality and consistency when engaging associates or contractors, and what a typical resource assignment process looks like.
